tools.name: search_products
tools.description: Search the live GENOSYS UAE catalog (Korean professional skincare, haircare, devices, beauty boxes). Use for any "what do you have for..." question. Accepts plain language in English, Russian or Arabic, plus optional filters. Returns name, price in AED (VAT included), size, stock, concerns and the p

tools.name: get_product
tools.description: Full details for one product: description, key features, benefits, key ingredients and actives, step-by-step how to use, sizes or shades with prices, and an add-to-bag link. Use the id from search_products (e.g. "18" or "68").

tools.name: recommend_routine
tools.description: Ranked product picks for a shopper's skin type and concerns, the same scoring as the skin quiz on genosys.ae. Use when someone describes their skin and asks what to use.

tools.name: list_categories
tools.description: All product categories and skin concerns in the live catalog, with product counts. Use to orient before searching.

tools.name: create_bag_link
tools.description: Build one link that opens genosys.ae with these items already in the shopper's bag, ready to check out. Use when the shopper decides to buy. Products with sizes or shades (see get_product options) need one picked: pass size, or color as its label or value (e.g. "#01 Bright").

tools.name: open_checkout
tools.description: Show the shopper a checkout form for these items: shade picker where needed, quantities, delivery details (name, email, phone, emirate, address), live total and a button that creates the order and opens secure Stripe payment. Use when the shopper wants to buy. Pass any details the shopper already ga

tools.name: place_order
tools.description: Create a GENOSYS UAE order from this chat and get a secure Stripe payment link (card, Apple Pay, Google Pay). Call only after the shopper has confirmed the items, the total and their delivery details. The order is confirmed by email once paid; unpaid orders are not shipped. Delivery is UAE only. Pri

tools.name: order_status
tools.description: Status and payment of a GENOSYS order. Needs the order number and the email used for the order.

tools.name: store_info
tools.description: Delivery areas, times and fees, payment methods, returns, contact (WhatsApp, email), apps and policies for GENOSYS UAE.

tools.name: search
tools.description: Search GENOSYS products and skincare articles. Returns ids to pass to fetch. ("product:<id>" for products, "blog:<slug>" for articles.)

tools.name: fetch
tools.description: Full text of a result from search, by id ("product:18" or "blog:<slug>").

findings.title: Generic tool name can shadow trusted tools
findings.detail: Tool "search" uses a generic high-value name. When multiple servers load together, this can intercept calls meant for a trusted server.

findings.title: Generic tool name can shadow trusted tools
findings.detail: Tool "fetch" uses a generic high-value name. When multiple servers load together, this can intercept calls meant for a trusted server.

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: open_checkout, place_order · Private data: store_info · Public sink: open_checkout, place_order, order_status, store_info.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: open_checkout, place_order · Private data: store_info · Public sink: open_checkout, place_order, order_status, store_info

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
